message.content:
Looking at the color timeline: it opens with muted brown/gray interior tones, moves into cool night‑blue and a few teal/pale‑blue highlights, has a single vivid red accent near the middle, then settles into a long stretch of deep royal blue (night‑time club/street lighting) before fading to black at the end. That combination—cold blue night scenes punctuated by a red neon accent and a dark fade‑out—matches the color‑graded look of The Weeknd ft. Daft Punk's "Starboy" video, rather than the warm/bright palettes of the other options (Roar, Dark Horse, Swalla, Sugar, All About That Bass, Love Me Like You Do) or the desaturated gray of "Hello" or the bright beach blues of "This Is What You Came For."

Answer: C
